title: A pin-only workflow change proved on the runner
assertion: A change to `mutation.yml` that moves only step action SHAs, same action on both sides and neither artifact action, runs every shard of money and ledger and no other; a tag, branch, job-level or artifact-action ref, or any other change to it, runs all four; a comment-only change runs none
noFileReason: Manifests, workspaces and workflows are synthetic, written to a temporary directory, or this repository's own; no file.
